_comment: App Runner service config. Deploy with: aws apprunner create-service --cli-input-json file://apprunner-config.json --profile tjrj
_cost_note: 0.25 vCPU / 0.5 GB = ~$5-10/month for 2-10 users. Pause service if unused: aws apprunner pause-service --service-arn <ARN>
_terminate_note: To delete after 2 months if unused: aws apprunner delete-service --service-arn <ARN>
_auto_scaling_note: Create auto-scaling config with MinSize=1 MaxSize=1 MaxConcurrency=25 to stay on single instance
